attempts.summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 and a persistent legacy origin on node2:8081. Only node2 requests to that origin and port are allowed; other ports, other destinations, and all CONNECT tunnels return 403. Both nodes passed sequential reboot-persistence verification with changed boot identities. Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71 were preserved.
